g.text: Telemetry Harvesting • Immutable SHA-256 Provenance • Entity Resolution • ACH Debate • Verifiable Citation Brief
• Links nodes: Person, Org, Wallet, IP
• Verifies each claim has Evidence ID
Human-in-the-Loop Analyst Verification & Verifiable Intelligence Export
• Lead investigator inspects cross-examination matrix and confidence intervals across competing hypotheses.
• Analyst can override model confidence score with mandatory justification note recorded in the immutable audit log.
• Exports attributed dossier in PDF/JSON/CSV with cryptographic SHA-256 verification hash appended to header.
Production-grade intelligence artifact: zero hallucinated citations, complete chain of custody
CORE ENGINEERING PRINCIPLES GOVERNING THE PIPELINE
• External APIs are called by deterministic
TypeScript fetch handlers, not LLM tool loops.
and testable mocking in offline environments.
• Every entity and relation must cite an Evidence
ID with a matching raw payload hash.
• BYO provider keys are encrypted using
AES-256-GCM before writing to the database.
